words.example: Smartphones brought major changes to our lives.

example_translations.ru: Смартфоны принесли в нашу жизнь значительные перемены.
example_translations.uz: Smartfonlar hayotimizga katta o'zgarishlar olib keldi.

words.example: Anna's teacher noticed an improvement in her English.

example_translations.ru: Учитель Анны заметил улучшение в её английском.
example_translations.uz: Annaning o'qituvchisi uning ingliz tilidagi yaxshilanishni sezdi.

words.example: People are worried about the rise in prices.
Reading helps children develop their imagination.

example_translations.uz: Kitob o'qish bolalarning tasavvurini rivojlantirishga yordam beradi.

words.example: The number of tourists increases every summer.
In winter the number of visitors decreased.
The growth of the city created many new jobs.

example_translations.ru: Рост города создал много новых рабочих мест.
example_translations.uz: Shaharning o'sishi ko'plab yangi ish o'rinlarini yaratdi.

words.example: Prices remained the same for two years.

example_translations.uz: Narxlar ikki yil davomida o'zgarishsiz qoldi.

words.example: Shopping online is a popular trend among young people.

example_translations.ru: Покупки в интернете — популярная тенденция среди молодёжи.
example_translations.uz: Internetda xarid qilish — yoshlar orasida ommabop tendensiya.

words.example: We live in a time of rapid change.

example_translations.ru: Мы живём во времена стремительных перемен.
